new_source_metadata_bindings.meaning: New captured metadata/source inputs only. No fresh original payload or old source-closure authority is established.

review_conclusions: An independent int.to_bytes-based reconstruction from the six new metadata documents equals the complete encoded byte string, beyond encoder/decoder agreement. Header188bytes, grammar first-appearance order2, stage4 order and all84 raw case records match the frozen field table.

Five header digests, little-endian unsigned lengths/indices/enums, raw body and grammar hashes, six ordered authored ternaries, eligibility/harness precedence and token caps are checked against the source-bound profile. Invalid-UTF8/NUL harness raw bytes remain present rather than repaired or decoded into a new document.

Decoder length caps precede field copies, record counts are fixed, source bindings reject well-shaped but wrong values, and exact consumption rejects trailing/short/reordered records. Rejected memoryview/bytearray/bytes subclasses are not coerced into accepted raw inputs.

The exact SourceBytes container and six exact size/hash pins precede metadata parsing and profile minting. The encoder/decoder require a factory-issued profile, not a dict or serialized ready flag. This is an ordinary source-interface boundary, not protection against hostile object.__new__/object.__setattr__/module mutation or authentication of original paths.

Required callbacks run across source hashing/parsing and bounded field/hash/copy steps. TimeoutError,KeyboardInterrupt,SystemExit preserve original exception identity at first/early/mid/final checkpoints and return no completed result. No clock is created or reset; cooperative checks do not preempt a single Python/C operation.

Factory and decoder results contain frozen dataclasses, tuples and exact immutable bytes. Legitimate returned nested records resist ordinary mutation, and to_dict returns fresh detached diagnostic containers. No diagnostic is a reusable validation capability.

The module imports only dataclasses/hashlib/json/re/struct and has no filesystem, path, source-loader, SDK, model, token-ID, native-observation or execution interface. Encoded expectations remain authored source claims; no tokenizer/grammar-membership or scientific observation is generated.
